scene: The sail flings you onto a transit platform overlooking distant districts.
picture: A level metal transfer platform runs along the bottom under the night sky. On the left, a glowing ferris wheel gondola hangs open. In the centre, the mustachioed man in his straw hat and poncho stands near a wheeled book cart on rails. On the far right, an open blue night bus idles.
shown: A glowing ferris wheel gondola waits open on the left platform edge.
